title: Ukraine announces recapture of Robotyne in Zaporizhzhia Oblast
body:
On 28 August 2023 Ukraine announced that its forces had retaken Robotyne, a village in Zaporizhzhia Oblast on the southern front. Deputy Defence Minister Hanna Maliar said on television that Robotyne had been liberated, according to an AFP report. She added that Ukrainian forces were also advancing southeast of Robotyne and south of the village of Mala Tokmachka.

Robotyne and Mala Tokmachka are both in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, which Russia claimed to have annexed in 2022 but never fully controlled militarily. The announcement came about twelve weeks into the counteroffensive, with the village on the front line of the southern axis.

AFP noted that Ukraine began its counteroffensive in June 2023 after building up Western-supplied weapons and assault battalions. Russian trench lines and minefields several kilometres deep had slowed the advance, and Ukraine had retaken only several villages in the south, which fuelled political debate over whether the offensive was succeeding.

In the same briefing Maliar said Ukrainian troops had recaptured one square kilometre near Bakhmut in the previous week and were advancing south of that town. She described Russian attempts to regain ground in the Kharkiv region as very intense.
